_about: A tiny, deliberately vulnerable Laravel-shaped project used only to measure what the gate finds. It is stored as JSON so that this repository's own scans and GitHub code scanning do not report it. benchmark/run_lab.py writes it to a temporary folder and scans it there. Never deploy it.

<?php
namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class OrderController extends Controller
{
    public function show(Request $request)
    {
        return Order::findOrFail($request->id);
    }

    public function update(Request $request)
    {
        $order = Order::find($request->id);
        $order->update($request->all());
        return $order;
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request)
    {
        Order::where('id', $request->id)->delete();
        return back();
    }

    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        return DB::select("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE note LIKE '%" . $request->q . "%'");
    }
}

files.app/Http/Controllers/ReceiptController.p:
<?php
namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\UpdateReceiptRequest;
use App\Models\Receipt;

class ReceiptController extends Controller
{
    // Route model binding with a policy check: safe.
    public function show(Receipt $receipt)
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $receipt);
        return $receipt;
    }

    // The FormRequest's authorize() checks the owner: safe.
    public function update(UpdateReceiptRequest $request, Receipt $receipt)
    {
        $receipt->update($request->validated());
        return $receipt;
    }
}
files.app/Http/Requests/UpdateReceiptRequest.p:
<?php
namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class UpdateReceiptRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return $this->route('receipt')->user_id === $this->user()->id;
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return ['note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:200']];
    }
}
